summary: A double-sided school science-lab island: a black epoxy worktop on two back-to-back runs of laminate base cab… joints door_f0, door_f1, door_f2, door_f3, door_b0, door_b1, …; options doors, seating; sockets seat_0, seat_1, seat_2, seat_3, work_f, work_b.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.science_lab_bench or place "prefab": "science_lab_bench" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
